format: Agent Skills evaluation cases: skills, query, files, expected_behavior (graded by a person or a grader agent after a real run). The extra `routing` block is checked automatically by `python3 scripts/check_skill.py --evals`, which runs `powers.py suggest` on the query and passes when one of `expect_any` (family prefixes) appears in the top `top_k` picks, `expect_domain` (if set) appears in the top 3, and `motion_output` (if set) matches whether suggest answered in motion mode.
